DocTestSetup = quote
    using ArbNumerics, Random
    Random.seed!(123)

# Seeing Values

## show, showall, string, stringall
```jldoctest
julia> using ArbNumerics

julia> string(ArbFloat(pi)^12)
"924269.1815233741862225791703584756071691383616271634"

julia> stringall(ArbFloat(pi)^12)
"924269.18152337418622257917035847560716914"

julia> setprecision(ArbReal, 168)
168

julia> show(ArbFloat(pi)^12)
924269.181523374186222579170358475607172922268940049306205412742848155024416498031192

julia> showall(ArbFloat(pi)^12)
924269.181523374186222579170358475607172922268940049306205
```

## `@sprintf`, `@printf`
```jldoctest
julia> using ArbNumerics, Printf

julia> @printf "%3.7f" ArbFloat(pi)^12
924269.1815234

julia> @sprintf "%3.12e" ArbReal(pi)^12
"9.242691815234e+05"
```
